🚀 mana | HTML
🎯 Primary Use Case: Conducting rogue access point attacks and Man-in-the-Middle (MitM) attacks.
✨ Key Features: • Modified hostapd for KARMA attacks (hostapd-mana) • Controller scripts for managing attacks (run-mana) • Tools for offloading EAP credential cracking (crackapd) • Modifications for sslstrip and HSTS bypass • Apache configurations for specific hacks
📖 Summary: The MANA Toolkit is a deprecated collection of tools designed for rogue access point (evilAP) attacks and Man-in-the-Middle (MitM) scenarios. It includes modified hostapd for enhanced KARMA attacks and utilities for post-connection MitM operations.
